references.label: Bishop bumper
references.description: The left pop bumper charges the action-button shot spotter.

references.label: Danger Room exit ramp
references.description: The lower-left mini-playfield exit multiplies multiball jackpots and supers.

references.label: Danger Room spinner
references.description: Use loops, ramps, standups, the Danger Room spinner, and the two bumpers to light the five city jackpots.

references.label: Gambit bumper
references.description: The right bumper or an alley pass arms the next mode or jackpot multiplier.

references.label: Highway ramp
references.description: After the combo threshold, shoot the lit Uptown, Midtown, or Highway ramp.

references.label: Midtown center ramp
references.description: The center ramp starts missions and future modes.

references.label: pop bumpers
references.description: A weak Midtown-ramp shot can enter the pop bumpers and feed the right outlane.

references.label: pop bumpers
references.description: A weak Midtown-ramp shot can enter the pop bumpers and feed the right outlane.

references.label: right inlane
references.description: From a controlled left flipper, test an alley pass through the right inlane into Gambit's bumper.

references.label: right outlane
references.description: A weak Midtown-ramp shot can enter the pop bumpers and feed the right outlane.

references.label: Giant Sentinel head
references.description: The center-right bash toy qualifies and scores Sentinel features.

references.label: Subway right loop
references.description: The right-center loop can start missions and complete future modes.

references.label: Subway shot
references.description: Start Save the City at the yellow Midtown or Subway shot.

references.label: Take the Uptown ramp
references.description: Take the Uptown ramp skill shot, then hit the Giant Sentinel until the first Sentinel Multiball is one or two clean hits from starting.

references.label: Uptown ramp
references.description: The left-center ramp collects the preferred skill shot, Cerebro, and Berserker Multiball.

references.label: X-Jet orbit
references.description: The left orbit feeds the Danger Room and collects city or Berserker supers.
